---
title: "Research Interests"
---

My research interests lie broadly in **Mathematical Analysis**, with particular emphasis on partial differential equations, dynamical systems, and problems arising in mathematical physics.

## Celestial Mechanics and the N-body Problem

I am interested in analytical and variational aspects of the **N-body problem**, including Hamilton–Jacobi equations, regularity properties, expansive solutions, and the behavior of solutions at infinity.

## Nonlinear Partial Differential Equations

My research includes the qualitative analysis of nonlinear PDEs, with particular interest in:

- Hamilton–Jacobi equations
- Parabolic equations
- Diffusion–convection–reaction equations
- Degenerate and sign-changing diffusion
- Traveling waves and wavefronts

## Asymptotic Analysis

I study asymptotic properties of solutions to elliptic and parabolic equations, including short-time behavior and problems related to the game-theoretic \(p\)-Laplacian and Pucci operators.

## Fluid Dynamics and Mathematical Models

I have also worked on PDE models arising in fluid dynamics and mathematical physics, including tropical climate models and the dynamics of complex bodies.
